about.title: About gpg4web
about.intro: gpg4web is a full OpenPGP client that runs entirely in your browser. All cryptography is performed locally by a Rust core compiled to WebAssembly — no key material, passphrase, or plaintext ever leaves your device.
about.feature1: Generate key pairs: Curve25519, Ed25519, RSA, NIST curves
about.feature2: 🛡 Post-quantum OpenPGP keys (IETF draft): ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, ML-KEM
about.feature3: Encrypt & decrypt messages to one or many recipients
about.feature4: Sign / encrypt / decrypt / verify files (binary or armored)
about.feature5: Inline, detached, and cleartext signatures + verification
about.feature6: Import / export armored keys, and a portable .gnupg home archive
about.pqVaultIntro: Your keyring is stored in localStorage, sealed with a post-quantum envelope:
about.pqVault1: ML-KEM-768 (NIST FIPS 203) wraps a fresh data key per save
about.pqVault3: Argon2id seals the KEM secret key under your master password
about.pqVaultHint: An attacker with your storage blob must defeat both Argon2id and ML-KEM — neither broken by a quantum computer.
about.sourceLicenseBody: gpg4web is free software, released under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (or later). The complete source code is available on GitHub — contributions and audits are welcome.

lock.tagline: GnuPG in your browser, powered by Rust + WebAssembly
lock.postQuantumNote: Your keyring is stored locally and sealed with a post-quantum envelope (ML-KEM-768 + AES-256-GCM, unlocked by your master password via Argon2id).

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoLockDesc: Lock the vault automatically when idle. Also re-checks on wake from sleep.
settings.backupHint: The .gnupg export produces a portable archive that the real gpg binary can import. The vault backup is the encrypted localStorage blob — safe to store anywhere, useless without your master password.
settings.dangerHint: Permanently remove the local vault and every key it contains.
settings.destroyConfirm: This permanently deletes your vault and ALL stored keys. This cannot be undone. Continue?
